meta.how: Items are the tool's own passages (src.passages, ord), in the order they should have come, with the grade I gave at stage 2 (normally the stage-1 grade of the stretch holding the passage; 'added_in_stage2' marks a passage no stage-1 stretch covered). shown_rank is the hybrid rank, null if not in the top 20. For the outline, 'opened' says whether any opened range overlaps the passage. 'acceptable' lists passages inside a judged stretch that I didn't single out; they aren't noise. 'noise' lists hybrid ranks, or outline ranges, holding no graded or acceptable passage.
